Design.evidence_source: In the dictator game, participants were randomly assigned to one of two conditions: "Baseline" or "Hidden information".

country.evidence_source: The experiment was conducted in the laboratory of the University of Zurich. Participants were recruited from the student population of the University of Zurich.

info_cost.evidence_source: In the Hidden information condition, dictators were not informed about the recipient's payoff by default, but could reveal it at no cost by clicking a button.

Sample.evidence_source: A total of 100 participants played the dictator game. 50 participants were in the Baseline condition and 50 participants were in the Hidden information condition.

N_Self_CI_Tmt.evidence_source: In the Hidden information condition, 30 out of 50 dictators chose Option A (selfish option).

N_Self_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: In the Baseline condition, 15 out of 50 dictators chose Option A (selfish option).

N_Altr_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: N_Tot_CI_Ctr from block_4: '50 participants were in the Baseline condition'. N_Self_CI_Ctr from block_5: 'In the Baseline condition, 15 out of 50 dictators chose Option A (selfish option)'. Derived: 50 - 15 = 35.

N_Tot_CI_Tmt.evidence_source: 50 participants were in the Hidden information condition.

N_Tot_CI_Ctr.evidence_source: 50 participants were in the Baseline condition
